text:
amy_sales: Heads up 1: prospect wants an air-gapped POC. They need a clear rollback + upgrade cadence story for infosec and procurement. Can we map out what we can guarantee for the POC?

matt_eng: Short answer: yes. We'll provide signed artifacts, a verified install flow, delta patches for minor fixes, and an explicit rollback command.

nora_se: Add to that: offline verification (sha256 + signature), clear key rotation steps, and an opt-out telemetry flag. They insisted on no outbound by default.

amy_sales: Procurement asked if emergency support during SOW is included or extra. Also ask about onsite help for first rollback.

sid_account: For pricing: emergency / after-hours support is an add-on (SLA Premium). Onsite validation day is a billable resource. We'll itemize in the SOW.

ops_lead: POC commitments we can make:
- Pinned build for the POC (no automatic upgrades)
- Security-only deltas during POC window
- 4-hour remote response for rollback assistance within agreed maintenance window
- Optional paid onsite validation day

matt_eng: Minimal technical flow for air-gap deployments: deliver a signed bundle with runtime, runtime deps, model files, manifests, and a CLI installer that supports `--compat-check` and `--rollback`. Example verify snippet we ship:

```
# verify signature + checksum
sha256sum -c redwood-2026.03.sha256 && gpg --verify redwood-2026.03.tar.gz.sig redwood-2026.03.tar.gz
# install
tar xzf redwood-2026.03.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood && /opt/redwood/bin/install --compat-check && systemctl restart redwood
```

matt_eng: If compat-check fails, installer exits nonzero and leaves node unchanged. Rollback is similarly single-command if backup exists:

```
# rollback to previous pinned artifact
/opt/redwood/bin/install --rollback --from /opt/redwood/backups/2026-03-01
```

nora_se: For large model weights (>30GB) we recommend either pre-seeded encrypted drives or a manifest + signed checks. We'll support signed deltas for model metadata but full model swaps may need physical transfer.

amy_sales: They also worry about upgrade cadence "noise". What's a conservative cadence we can promise?

matt_eng: Recommended cadence: security patches: monthly, minor: 2-3 months, major: ~6 months. For POC we can freeze on a single commit and only deliver security fixes as deltas.

sid_account: Procurement wants explicit SLA language: time-to-rollback-assist and whether rollback can be executed by customer without support. Can we allow self-service rollback?

ops_lead: Yes, we provide a self-service rollback path with preflight checks. POC acceptance criterion: customer can run rollback command and pass smoke tests. We'll offer remote assist within 4 hours during maintenance window. For enterprise SOWs we have 1h/4h/24h tiers.

nora_se: Security questionnaire notes: we will supply GPG key fingerprints, sha256 lists, CVE bulletins per release, and optional HSM/KMS integration notes for key rotation.

amy_sales: They requested a one-page runbook to hand to infra. Can we draft a concise rollback playbook?

matt_eng: I'll draft the playbook today. High-level steps: stop service (graceful), backup KV/cache, verify artifact, run install/rollback, run smoke tests, validate metrics. Commands included.

ops_lead: Quick backup example we give customers:
```
# local backup
/opt/redwood/bin/backup --output /tmp/redwood-backup-$(date +%F).tar.gz
```

ops_lead: And a smoke-check example:
```
/opt/redwood/bin/smoke-check --endpoint localhost:8080/health --expected "ok"
```

sid_account: Good. I'll include line items in the SOW: onsite eng day, premium SLA, annual signed-delta hosting, private registry connector license. I'll attach numbers by EOD.

amy_sales: Infosec also wants to confirm privacy: confirm that logs and audit trails remain local by default.

nora_se: Confirmed: telemetry is off by default. Audit logs are local files and included in the POC bundle. If they opt-in we provide an encrypted upload tool with explicit config.

matt_eng: Note on deltas: delta artifacts are signed and verified same as full bundles. Size savings typically 10-25% depending on churn. For kernel-level changes we do full swap.

ops_lead: Operational constraint: if customer has strict freeze weeks (quarter-end), we can schedule emergency security deltas but will require approval. For POC we can pre-agree skip windows.

amy_sales: They asked whether we can run the first rollback together as a dry-run.

ops_lead: Offer: one remote dry-run included, or paid onsite to run it in their environment. We'll propose remote first, onsite if they prefer.

deploy-bot: artifact-check redwood/poc-bundle/1765234568 passed signatures and manifests uploaded to staging (airgap-preview). :white_check_mark:

matt_eng: Action items:
- Draft 1-page rollback playbook + sample commands (ETA: today EOD)
- Add `--compat-check` output to smoke tests and CI snippet

nora_se: Action items:
- Prepare signed advisory template + key rotation guide for air-gapped (ETA: 2 business days)

sid_account: Action items:
- Draft SOW pricing lines and attach numbers (ETA: EOD)

amy_sales: I'll share this thread with the customer's infra + procurement and book a scoping call next week. Thanks team :pray:

ops_lead: +1. Keep the POC pinned build and document acceptance criteria: self-service rollback success + passing smoke tests.

amy_sales: Closing: customer wants single-command rollback if preflight passes 1. We'll mark that as POC acceptance.

matt_eng: I'll push the playbook into the POC repo and link in the SOW.
